description: Create end-to-end test suite exercising three canonical flows: (1) new MCP discovery through scanner, signal scoring, verdict assignment, attestation generation, UI visibility; (2) manual override via manual_override_api with audit trail verification; (3) threat intel correlation through risk_ranker and verdict adjustment. Must use write_service endpoints, not direct DB access. Include assertions for verdict tier boundaries per spec section 2. Exit 0 on success, non-zero on failure.
